title.narrative: Emergency Response for Support of Yenga Displaced Persons

description.narrative:
The project is designed to ensure rapid action, aiming to deliver assistance to crisis-affected populations within 21 days and concluding within 90 days. The response activities will begin with the project launch, followed by a rapid needs and market assessment(s). Afterward, participants will be registered and verified before the distribution of Multi-Purpose Cash Assistance (MPCA). As a result, individuals affected by the crisis may not receive support within the first two weeks of the intervention. This is a three-month response initiative aimed at providing Caritas Kenema with valuable learning to enhance its capacity to implement START Fund projects within a 45-day timeframe. Caritas Kenema conducted an assessment visit on 10th May 2025 to engage directly with the displaced individuals and understand their current conditions.
The estimated number of affected individuals is 262 (44 HHs), from two communities. This includes 172 (29 HHs) persons who are displaced (24 men, 52 women, 56 girls, 38 boys and 2 individuals living with disabilities) and 90 (15 HHs) host community individuals (14 men, 20 women, 29 girls, 27 boys) who are providing billeting arrangements for those displaced. CAFOD is allocating £16,660.21 from GEF to implement a 3-month response project to support displaced families in Kissi Teng Chiefdom.
